english.title: Give false/misleading information to the CMA in connection with its digital markets functions
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) gave information to the Competition and Markets Authority in connection with the CMA's digital markets functions which was false or misleading in a material particular, namely **(..SPECIFY FALSE OR MISLEADING MATERIAL..), knowing or being reckless as to whether it was false or misleading

english.notes:
(i) It is also an offence to give information to another which is false or misleading where the person knows that the information will be given to the CMA in connection with its digital markets functions, see section 94(2) of the Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act 2024 and H101713.
(ii) For offences by body corporates see section 96.
(iii) Extra-territorial jurisdiction: for restriction of this offence in relation to acts done by a person who is outside the United Kingdom, see sections 94(3) and 97 of the Act.
(iv) The CMA may not impose a penalty on a person under section 87 in relation to an act or omission which constitutes this offence, if the person has, in relation to that act or omission, been found guilty of that offence, and a person may not be found guilty of this offence by virtue of an act or omission which constitutes this offence, see sections 87 and 92.
(v) A statement by a person in response to a requirement imposed by virtue of section 72 (a "section 72 statement" may be used in evidence against that person on a prosecution for this offence, for details see section 73.
